nom: L'Oréal Revitalift Melasyl Dark Spot Creamy - Serum

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination/oily skin reports the serum felt light and not oily, working well for her skin type without causing breakouts.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one who also describes it as combination/oily, report the texture absorbs without feeling greasy and works well under makeup.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive, including one managing rosacea-prone skin and one who is fragrance-sensitive, generally report the serum was well tolerated with no reaction, though one reviewer on the sensitive side experienced an initial burning sensation.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature or in their 40s report added firmness, glow and brighter-looking skin, alongside the dark-spot fading also reported by other users in this age group.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers report modest gains, such as reduced fine lines, plumper-looking lip lines or better firmness, after several weeks to two months of use, but others explicitly say they saw no real change in wrinkles or fine lines over a similar period.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as hydrating, leaving skin plump and not dried out even with daily use; one reviewer is a clear exception, reporting drier skin with no fading or improvement after consistent use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report a slight stinging or reddened reaction in the first days that faded as their skin adjusted, and one with rosacea-prone skin had no reaction at all; others report reduced redness or an 'angry' look calming with weeks of use, though a couple describe skin that stayed irritated and itchy.
concerns.spots: Reports are split: many reviewers, including some with sun spots, melasma or age spots, describe visible fading or lightening of dark spots after three to eight weeks of consistent use, while a substantial number of others, including one tracking one specific spot for over a month, report no visible change in color or size at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, including some who describe themselves as acne-prone, and one notes existing blemishes fading lighter with use; one reviewer dissents, reporting more breakouts that she attributes to the fragrance and that stopped only after she discontinued use, and another had a few new breakouts when she first started before her skin improved.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the cream left her feeling oily by the end of the day, while another with combination/oily skin found it absorbed without feeling oily or greasy.

extraits.texte: First let me say what I liked. The texture of the product is amazing and creamy. The twist and pump with the packaging is great. Now the cons. The product is so strong in terms of fragrance I hated it. I also noticed that I was getting more breakouts from it. If I had to guess it is from the fragrance. It has some good skin loving ingredients in it but my face ultimately didn't like it. I discontinued use of it and haven't seen any bump since. I wouldn't recommend if your face is sensitive to fragrance.

I really wanted this serum to work, but unfortunately it didn't make a difference for my dark spots. I used it consistently as directed and only noticed dryer skin no fading or improvement. The texture is nice and it absorbs well without feeling greasy. But the smell is unpleasant I hated the smell.

extraits.titre: Smooths skin but doesn't fade discoloration
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum is nice for my mature, combination skin, leaving it feeling incredibly smooth. However, it did not live up to to its main claim, as I saw no visible improvement or brightening of my dullness or dark spots. It's nice for texture, but not for discoloration.

extraits.titre: My dark spots are visibly brighter and smoother
extraits.texte: [I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.] I've been using the L'Oreal Paris Triple Power Melasyl Cream serum consistently for about 7 weeks now. I am genuinely impressed with the results so far. The serum has a smooth, lightweight texture with a slight tint that blends into my skin effortlessly without feeling greasy or heavy. It also didn't sting or irritate my skin. The pump dispenses the perfect amount of product, and being able to close it after each use keeps the nozzle clean without leaving product residue behind. The bottle is also super cute and looks great on my vanity. My only suggestion would be to add the expiration date to the packaging. The biggest change I've noticed was my hyperpigmentation spots and overall skin tone. My before and after photos show that my ￼hyperpigmentation has definitely faded and they are much lighter than when I started. While my dark spots haven't disappeared completely, they are less visible, and my complexion looks more even. My skin also feels softer and more hydrated. Overall, I would absolutely purchase this product. There is definite improvement in my hyperpigmention/dark spots. My skin looks brighter and smoother looking. I'm excited to see what even long-term results look like.

Wow what a change! I was skeptical about this product at first since I've used other similar serums with no luck but this one surprised me! The consistency of the serum was light and smooth, not oily at all! But hydrating at the same time. My skin felt protected and cared for. The serum felt very light and worked with my combination/oily skin. After 4 weeks, I've noticed the texture of my skin appears smoother, supple, and not as "tired". My dark spots also lightened slightly and overall my skin feels less angry/red. I definitely feel that this one is a keeper because it also didn't cause any breakouts! I love it..feels so luxurious!
